why.org_a:finding:06846: This KEV finding is on an Internet-facing web server that has a direct network route to the database storing the crown-jewel bucket's secret.

reasoning: The crown-jewel data store org_a:ds:00001 is unlocked by specific database secrets, including org_a:secret:00001 stored on ember-vane-data-401. Internet-facing web server ember-sol-edge-181 can directly reach ember-vane-data-401 on port 5432 and has an open KEV finding (org_a:finding:06846). Fixing this finding cuts the most direct external attack path to the crown jewels.
